tools.name: estimate_take_home_pay
tools.description: Estimates a Malaysian employee's monthly take-home pay from gross salary: EPF/KWSP, SOCSO/PERKESO, EIS/SIP, LINDUNG 24 Jam and PCB (monthly tax deduction), plus employer contributions. Pay dates 2026-06-01 to 2027-12-31; the date picks the tax year (YA2026 or YA2027 Belanjawan 2027). This is an ESTI
